question: With which of the following Indian states is the cultural festival of Shad Suk Mynsiem associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shad Suk Mynsiem** is the most important festival of the **Khasi clans of Meghalaya.**
 
• This festival is celebrated in **April**, every year for thanksgiving mother of nature for a good harvest and for fresh showing seeds.
 
• This is an extraordinary celebration of moves, also known as the " **move of cheerful hearts**".
